description: Oil and gas extraction balance-sheet skeleton for SIC 1311 retaining all 186 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied ConocoPhillips presentation guides broad classified presentation. Producing costs, successful-efforts and full-cost property measurements preserve separate scopes; issuer coverage and hierarchy imply no arithmetic.
classification_notes: All 186 supplied unique concepts appear once. The SIC inventory covers multiple issuers, accounting methods and legal ownership forms; it does not assert that ConocoPhillips reports every concept.

The reference presentation guides classified current/noncurrent presentation only. No unsupported cash-plus-investments, net-debt or component subtotal is manufactured; dashes or zeros do not prove a taxonomy mapping.
General PP&E, producing costs, successful-efforts property and full-cost property can overlap. Accounting methods and reserve-status views are not additive asset categories.

Full-cost gross/net property definitions cover property subject to amortization. Capitalized unproved/development costs excluded from amortization are kept separate. Full-cost depletion is accumulated depletion, not annual expense.

Producing-cost accumulated deductions include valuation allowances. Successful-efforts DD&A-only and DD&A-plus-impairment are distinct overlapping deductions; net asset values already reflect their corresponding deductions.

Joint-interest billing receivables are claims on nonoperator partners. Accrued royalties and oil/gas sales payable preserve distinct obligations rather than being assumed equivalent to trade payables or customer liabilities.

Current/noncurrent classifications follow explicit definitions. Unsplit debt, notes, ARO, accruals, restricted cash, joint-interest receivables and other unspecified balances remain outside classified subtotals.

LongTermDebt is after debt adjustments and not limited to noncurrent maturities; DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount is before premium/discount and issuance costs under the 2026 definition. Face value at issuance is supplementary.
LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations is explicitly noncurrent in the definition; DebtCurrent includes leases and short-term borrowing. Debt instrument/maturity/seniority views overlap.
Recognized current/noncurrent derivatives differ from generic before-master-netting fair values. Deferred financing costs may be asset balances or debt deductions depending on arrangement.
Shares and per-share values, debt terms, liquidation preference excess, commitments and unresolved deposit/allowance candidates remain supplementary.
Contra flags identify accumulated asset deductions, credit allowances, treasury stock and subscription receivable candidates without prescribing sign reversal. Missing facts are not zero.

metadata_contract.period_type: All 186 supplied concepts verified as instant in official US GAAP 2026.
metadata_contract.unit_type: 172 monetary, 10 shares and 4 per-share concepts verified from the official schema; currency and scale come from source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: True for accumulated DD&A/impairment, allowances, treasury stock and subscription-note contra-equity candidate; no automatic sign inversion or duplicate deduction from net balances.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 186 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 1311.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

children.label: Current cash and investments
children.classification_note: Cash excludes equivalents while cash/equivalents is the broader cash measure. Short-term and marketable investment views overlap; do not infer a reported combined subtotal.

children.label: Cash and cash equivalents at carrying value

concepts.name: us-gaap:Cash
concepts.review_reason: Cash alone excludes cash equivalents and is a subset of cash-and-cash-equivalents; it is not an additional balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Short-term investments can include marketable current securities supplied separately; distinguish investment holdings from cash equivalents.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Marketable current securities may be included in short-term investments; do not add both unless the issuer populations are disjoint.

children.label: Current restricted cash
children.classification_note: Restricted cash alone is narrower than restricted cash/equivalents; source facts determine inclusion in reported cash and restriction treatment.

children.label: Restricted cash and cash equivalents at carrying value
Current receivables
children.classification_note: Total, trade, accounts-plus-other, joint-interest and tax receivables are overlapping views. Joint-interest claims are due from nonoperator partners; allowances are already included in net balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ReceivablesNetCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current receivables net can contain trade, joint-interest and other receivables; use aggregate or reconciled component populations.

children.label: Accounts and other receivables net current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsAndOtherReceivablesNetCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Combined current accounts and other receivables overlap current trade, other and total receivable measures; select one reconciled presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNetCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Trade receivables net can already be included in current total receivables or combined accounts-and-other receivables; select the issuer aggregate or reconciled components.

children.label: Oil and gas joint interest billing receivables current

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasJointInterestBillingReceivablesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current joint-interest billing receivables are due from nonoperator partners, not necessarily customer trade receivables; they can be included in other/current total receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherReceivablesNetCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current receivables may include joint-interest, tax or other balances supplied separately; establish residual exclusions.

children.label: Allowance for doubtful accounts receivable current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: The current receivable allowance is a deduction already included in net current receivables; it may overlap the broader premiums/other receivable allowance.

children.label: Current inventory
children.classification_note: Crude oil/NGL product inventory is contained in inventory totals where reported; producing property is a separate long-lived asset.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InventoryNet
concepts.review_reason: Total inventory can include crude oil and NGL inventory supplied separately; do not add product detail to the net inventory aggregate.

children.label: Crude oil and natural gas liquids

concepts.name: us-gaap:CrudeOilAndNaturalGasLiquids
concepts.review_reason: Crude oil and NGL inventory can be included in total inventory net; product inventory is not an oil/gas producing-property balance.

children.label: Current prepayments, deposits and other assets
children.classification_note: Posted security deposits are assets and differ from deposit liabilities. Combined prepaids/other assets overlap separate prepaid and residual balances.

children.label: Prepaid expense and other assets current

concepts.name: us-gaap:PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: The combined current prepaid/other asset amount includes narrower prepayments and residual assets, so it is an alternative to matched components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PrepaidTaxes
concepts.review_reason: Prepaid taxes provide benefits within one year or the operating cycle under the definition; they can already be included in prepaid expenses and are not equivalent to income tax refund receivables.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current assets may already include prepaid expenses, tax receivables and security deposits; establish residual exclusions.

children.label: Current derivative assets
children.classification_note: Maturity-specific recognized assets can differ from the generic before-master-netting fair-value disclosure retained in supplementary disclosures.

children.label: Current disposal-group assets
children.classification_note: Disposal-group assets can include previously classified asset categories; do not add the pre-reclassification balances again.

children.label: Noncurrent investments and financing receivables
children.classification_note: Long-term investments overlap affiliate and equity-method holdings; financing receivables can also be included in reported investment totals. Investments held differ from NCI equity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Long-term investments can include equity-method investments and noncurrent financing receivables; reconcile issuer investment categories before combining.

children.label: Affiliate, subsidiary, associate and JV investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentsInAffiliatesSubsidiariesAssociatesAndJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: The broad affiliate/subsidiary/associate/JV investment measure can include equity-method investments; distinguish consolidated entities and avoid adding the narrower balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method investments can be contained in the broader affiliates/subsidiaries/JV investment amount; they differ from noncontrolling equity in consolidated subsidiaries.

children.label: Notes and loans receivable net noncurrent
PP&E and producing assets
children.classification_note: General PP&E, producing-cost and accounting-method scopes overlap. Gross/net/accumulated alternatives are not additive; successful-efforts and full-cost views describe alternative accounting populations.

children.label: General PP&E measures
children.classification_note: Net PP&E already reflects corresponding accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization. Components can include oil/gas and leased assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross PP&E can include oil/gas producing properties and finance-lease asset views separately supplied; reconcile asset scope before adding components.

children.label: PP&E accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmortizationPropertyPlantAndEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Accumulated PP&E depreciation/depletion/amortization can include the separately supplied oil/gas method-specific deductions and is already reflected in net PP&E.

children.label: General PP&E component views
children.classification_note: Other PP&E has gross, net and accumulated variants; land and machinery may overlap oil/gas support assets. No gross-to-net equation is inferred without matched scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MachineryAndEquipmentGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross machinery/equipment can include oil/gas support equipment supplied separately and can already be included in gross PP&E.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOther
concepts.review_reason: Other PP&E is explicitly before DD&A despite the absence of Gross in its name; distinguish the gross residual from other PP&E net and accumulated deductions.

children.label: Property plant and equipment other net

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherNet
concepts.review_reason: Other PP&E net already reflects accumulated deductions and can overlap the broader net PP&E total; it is not additive to the gross other-PP&E alternative.

children.label: Property plant and equipment other accumulated depreciation

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherAccumulatedDepreciation
concepts.review_reason: Other PP&E accumulated depreciation includes depletion and amortization under the definition and is already reflected in other PP&E net.

children.label: Capitalized oil/gas producing-cost measures
children.classification_note: These producing-cost disclosures can be included in PP&E and method-specific property balances. Proved, unproved and support costs are gross scopes; accumulated deductions include valuation allowance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOilAndGasProducingActivitiesNet
concepts.review_reason: Net capitalized producing costs can overlap successful-efforts or full-cost property balances and PP&E; it is not an extra asset category to add to those totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOilAndGasProducingActivitiesGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross capitalized producing costs may already be included in gross PP&E; proved, unproved and support-equipment views overlap accounting-method property views.

children.label: Producing-cost accumulated DD&A and valuation allowance

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsAccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAmortizationAndValuationAllowanceForRelatingToOilAndGasProducingActivities
concepts.review_reason: This accumulated producing-cost deduction includes valuation allowances in addition to DD&A and differs from DD&A-only method-specific measures; net capitalized costs already reflect it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsProvedProperties
concepts.review_reason: Gross proved-property capitalized costs can be included in total producing costs and successful-efforts proved property; do not combine accounting-method and reserve-status views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsUnprovedProperties
concepts.review_reason: Gross unproved-property capitalized costs can overlap successful-efforts unproved assets and full-cost excluded costs; their accounting-method coverage is not equivalent.

children.label: Producing support equipment and facilities, gross

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsSupportEquipmentAndFacilities
concepts.review_reason: Gross producing support equipment/facility costs can overlap machinery/equipment and producing-property totals; do not add accounting-function and asset-type views.

children.label: Successful-efforts oil/gas property
children.classification_note: Gross proved/unproved/other properties can be components of total successful-efforts property. DD&A-only and DD&A-plus-impairment are overlapping deductions; net property already reflects impairment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodNet
concepts.review_reason: Successful-efforts net property already includes DD&A and impairment; the DD&A-only and DD&A-plus-impairment deductions are alternative supporting views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodGross
concepts.review_reason: Successful-efforts gross property can include proved, unproved and residual property supplied separately and can already be part of total PP&E.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethod
concepts.review_reason: Successful-efforts proved-property gross cost can overlap proved producing-cost capitalized balances; reconcile accounting-method and reserve-status scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnprovedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethod
concepts.review_reason: Unproved successful-efforts property excludes accumulated DD&A and impairment and can overlap unproved capitalized producing costs; do not treat reserve-status views as separate asset populations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethod
concepts.review_reason: Other successful-efforts oil/gas property is a residual in the method-specific property population; establish whether its measurement matches the gross or net aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodAccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Successful-efforts accumulated DD&A excludes impairment, unlike the combined DD&A/impairment measure; select the deduction matching the gross/net property basis.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodAccumulatedDepreciationDepletionAmortizationAndImpairment
concepts.review_reason: Successful-efforts accumulated DD&A plus impairment includes the separately supplied DD&A-only deduction; do not deduct both from gross property.

children.label: Full-cost oil/gas property
children.classification_note: Gross/net full-cost tags concern property subject to amortization. Accumulated depletion is a balance, not annual expense. Unproved/development costs excluded from amortization retain a distinct population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodNet
concepts.review_reason: Full-cost net property covers properties subject to amortization and is after accumulated depletion; unproved/development costs excluded from amortization require separate scope reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodGross
concepts.review_reason: Full-cost gross property is restricted to properties subject to amortization; the supplied excluded unproved/development capitalized costs are not automatically part of this balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasPropertyFullCostMethodDepletion
concepts.review_reason: Full-cost depletion is accumulated depletion under the official definition, not current-period depletion expense; it is already reflected in the full-cost net property amount.

children.label: Full-cost unproved/development costs excluded from amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalizedCostsOfUnprovedPropertiesExcludedFromAmortizationCumulative
concepts.review_reason: Full-cost capitalized costs excluded from amortization include unproved property and development projects, including capitalized interest; they are not an extra deduction from amortizable net property.

children.label: Combined PP&E and finance ROU asset measures
children.classification_note: Combined PP&E/finance ROU totals overlap standalone PP&E and finance ROU assets; select one consistent gross/net and accumulated-depreciation scope.

children.label: PP&E and finance ROU assets, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAfterAccumulatedDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: The combined net PP&E/finance-lease ROU asset amount can contain both standalone net PP&E and finance ROU assets; choose the aggregate or matched components.

children.label: PP&E and finance ROU assets, gross

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetBeforeAccumulatedDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: The combined gross PP&E/finance-lease ROU amount overlaps standalone gross PP&E and is an alternative scope; match its accumulated deduction to the same population.

children.label: PP&E and finance ROU accumulated depreciation/amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAccumulatedDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Combined PP&E and finance-lease ROU accumulated depreciation/amortization overlaps standalone PP&E and finance-lease asset deductions and is already reflected in the combined net amount.

children.label: Lease ROU assets
children.classification_note: Lessee operating and finance ROU assets differ from producing costs; finance ROU may already be included in the combined PP&E/finance ROU total.

children.label: Operating lease right of use asset
Finance lease right of use asset
Goodwill and intangible assets
children.classification_note: Finite-lived intangibles are part of intangibles excluding goodwill. Accumulated amortization is already included in net values; goodwill remains distinct.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: Intangibles excluding goodwill can contain finite-lived and indefinite-lived assets; the finite-lived-only amount is a narrower alternative, not an additional asset.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet
concepts.review_reason: Finite-lived intangibles net are a subset of intangibles excluding goodwill and already reflect amortization; do not add both net amounts.

children.label: Finite lived intangible assets accumulated amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Finite-lived intangible accumulated amortization is already reflected in finite-lived intangibles net and does not establish gross intangible assets by itself.

children.label: Noncurrent restricted cash and posted deposits
children.classification_note: Restricted cash/equivalents contain restricted cash-only amounts; posted security deposits are not deposit liabilities and may require cash classification review.

children.label: Restricted cash and cash equivalents noncurrent
Deferred tax and other noncurrent assets
children.classification_note: Deferred tax assets are after jurisdictional offsets. Miscellaneous residual assets can be part of broader other noncurrent assets; deferred financing costs require facility/debt presentation review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNoncurrentNet
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent deferred financing costs can be eligible facility assets or debt deductions; confirm facility terms and avoid adding costs already netted in debt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent assets can include the miscellaneous noncurrent residual and separately mapped deposits or other assets; establish exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsMiscellaneousNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Miscellaneous noncurrent assets can be a residual within total other noncurrent assets; establish exclusions for separately reported deposits and investments.

children.label: Noncurrent derivative assets
children.classification_note: Maturity-specific recognized derivative assets can differ from generic before-master-netting fair-value disclosures retained separately.

children.label: Noncurrent disposal-group assets
children.classification_note: Disposal-group totals can contain asset types formerly reported elsewhere; avoid duplication after reclassification.

children.label: Assets with unresolved maturity
children.classification_note: Do not force these all-maturity or unspecified balances into current/noncurrent subtotals. They can overlap explicitly classified balances; group membership never defines arithmetic.

children.label: Cash and receivables without maturity split
children.classification_note: Restricted cash/equivalents, trade and joint-interest receivables can contain narrower current/noncurrent balances; determine maturity and source presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash and equivalents have no current/noncurrent split and overlap the explicitly classified restricted balances; do not assign maturity from the name.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: AccountsReceivableNet has no explicit maturity classification; distinguish it from current trade receivables and keep its current/noncurrent coverage unresolved.

children.label: Oil and gas joint interest billing receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasJointInterestBillingReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Joint-interest billing receivables without maturity split can include the current nonoperator-partner receivables supplied separately; maturity is unresolved.

children.label: Investments and other assets without maturity split
children.classification_note: Investment totals, escrow and residual assets require issuer maturity and asset-role review; financing costs may instead be debt deductions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Investments
concepts.review_reason: Investments does not establish current versus noncurrent classification and can include both short/long-term and equity-method investments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EscrowDeposit
concepts.review_reason: EscrowDeposit does not establish current versus noncurrent classification or whether the account is restricted cash; determine issuer balance-sheet presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNet
concepts.review_reason: Debt issuance costs net of amortization may be deductions from debt or assets for eligible facilities; maturity and issuer presentation are unresolved, so do not classify automatically as an asset.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: OtherAssets has no maturity restriction and can include current and noncurrent residuals; do not assign it automatically to other noncurrent assets.

children.label: Current debt and borrowing measures
children.classification_note: DebtCurrent includes leases and short-term borrowing. Current long-term debt/lease aggregates overlap standalone debt, notes and lease principal; note categories are instrument views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current debt includes lease obligations under the official definition and can contain current long-term debt, short-term borrowing and lease principal balances.

children.label: Long term debt and capital lease obligations current

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current long-term debt and lease obligations include the current portion of originally long-term borrowings and leases, unlike all current debt which can also include short-term borrowings.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShortTermBorrowings
concepts.review_reason: Short-term borrowing differs from current maturities of originally long-term debt but is included in total current debt; distinguish drawn credit lines already included.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConvertibleNotesPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current convertible notes are a subset of current long-term note debt and can be included in other current debt aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNotesPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current notes are current maturities of originally long-term notes classified as other; distinguish them from newly issued short-term borrowings.

children.label: Current lease liabilities
children.classification_note: Finance/operating lease liabilities can already be included in debt-and-lease aggregates; select consistent scope.

children.label: Current payables and accruals
children.classification_note: Combined payables/accrual totals contain narrower trade, other payables and accruals; royalty, payroll and interest details may already be included.

children.label: Accounts payable and accrued liabilities current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Combined current payables and accruals contain separately reported payable and accrued liability measures; do not add those details to the aggregate.

children.label: Accounts payable and other accrued liabilities current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableAndOtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current accounts payable plus other accruals can exclude accrual categories included in the all-payables-and-accruals aggregate; reconcile issuer scope rather than equating them.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Accounts payable current can overlap trade payables and combined payables/accruals; identify the issuer scope before adding other payable categories.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableTradeCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Trade accounts payable can be included in total current accounts payable and combined accrual aggregates; do not combine those overlapping views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccountsPayableOtherCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current payables are a residual within all current accounts payable and may overlap combined other-payable/accrual measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current accrued liabilities can include interest, royalties, payroll and tax accruals supplied separately; select a consistent residual or aggregate view.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current accruals may be included in all accrued liabilities or combined other-payables/accruals; identify the excluded payroll, interest and tax categories.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeRelatedLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Employee-related current liabilities can include deferred compensation or payroll-related accruals reported separately; determine which taxes and benefits are included.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedRoyaltiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Accrued royalties may be included in accounts payable or other accrued liabilities; identify whether reported payable totals already contain this oil/gas-specific obligation.

children.label: Oil and gas sales payable current

concepts.name: us-gaap:OilAndGasSalesPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: This current payable concerns oil/gas sold but not delivered to third parties under the definition; it is not interchangeable with accrued royalties or customer-contract liabilities.

children.label: Current tax liabilities
children.classification_note: All-tax payables overlap income, payroll, sales/excise and other-than-income tax categories. Residual other-tax categories are not automatically disjoint.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxesPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: All current tax payables can contain income, payroll, sales/excise and other tax accruals supplied separately; select aggregate or reconciled categories.

children.label: Accrual for taxes other than income taxes current

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccrualForTaxesOtherThanIncomeTaxesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other-than-income tax accruals can include payroll and sales/excise taxes; distinguish residual coverage before adding the specific tax balances.

children.label: Sales and excise tax payable current

concepts.name: us-gaap:SalesAndExciseTaxPayableCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Sales and excise tax payable is a subset of broader tax payable/other-than-income-tax accruals; avoid adding subset and aggregate.

children.label: Current customer and distribution liabilities
children.classification_note: Deferred revenue can include customer-contract obligations; dividends payable differ from actual cash dividends.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredRevenueCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current deferred revenue includes deferred income and customer obligations and can contain the current customer-contract liability tag.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current customer-contract liabilities can be included in deferred revenue; identify revenue-accounting scope before combining the two.

children.label: Current ARO, derivatives and other obligations
children.classification_note: ARO is the current retirement obligation and differs from lease obligations. Derivative and acquisition liabilities may already be included in other current balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Current contingent consideration is an acquisition-related liability and may be included in other current liabilities; it is not automatically debt principal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLiabilitiesCurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other current liabilities may include accruals, customer liabilities and current ARO; establish exclusions before using separate details.

children.label: Current disposal-group liabilities
children.classification_note: Disposal-group obligations can contain previously classified liabilities and must not be duplicated.

children.label: Noncurrent debt measures
children.classification_note: The debt-plus-capital-lease aggregate is explicitly noncurrent despite its name. Note form, seniority and conversion rights overlap total noncurrent debt.

children.label: Long term debt and capital lease obligations

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations
concepts.review_reason: Despite the unsuffixed name, the official definition classifies this debt-and-lease obligation aggregate as noncurrent; it overlaps separate noncurrent debt and lease liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ConvertibleLongTermNotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent convertible notes are a subset of long-term note/debt balances; do not add them to the corresponding aggregate.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SeniorLongTermNotes
concepts.review_reason: SeniorLongTermNotes excludes current maturities while SeniorNotes includes them; the noncurrent amount can already be included in noncurrent debt.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLongTermDebtNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent long-term debt is a residual within total noncurrent debt and can overlap note or seniority views.

children.label: Noncurrent lease liabilities
children.classification_note: Standalone lease balances may already be included in the noncurrent debt-and-lease aggregate.

children.label: Noncurrent asset retirement obligations
children.classification_note: Legal retirement obligations differ from leases, employee pensions and current ARO; reconcile inclusion in broader nondebt liability totals.

children.label: Deferred tax liability alternatives
children.classification_note: Gross deferred tax liability and jurisdictionally net liability are overlapping alternatives, not additive components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Deferred tax liabilities before the net-of-deferred-tax-asset measure overlap the net liability alternative; reconcile jurisdictional offsets rather than summing both.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilitiesNet
concepts.review_reason: Net deferred tax liabilities include jurisdictional deferred tax asset offsets; they are an alternative to gross deferred tax liabilities.

children.label: Noncurrent employee obligations
children.classification_note: Pension/postretirement and deferred compensation can be included in broad nondebt liabilities; classification does not imply funding cash outflows.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlansLiabilitiesNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: The combined noncurrent pension/postretirement liability can be included in the broad nondebt liability total; distinguish it from employee current accruals.

children.label: Noncurrent derivatives and residual liabilities
children.classification_note: Other accruals can be part of other liabilities. Total nondebt liabilities can contain derivatives, ARO, employee and deferred tax balances supplied separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAccruedLiabilitiesNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Other noncurrent accruals can be included in other noncurrent liabilities or broad current/noncurrent accruals; identify the residual scope.

children.label: Liabilities other than longterm debt noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesOtherThanLongtermDebtNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent liabilities excluding long-term debt can contain leases, ARO, deferred tax, pension and other nondebt obligations; it is not equivalent to residual other noncurrent liabilities.

children.label: Noncurrent disposal-group liabilities
children.classification_note: Obligations within disposal groups may already be reflected by narrower liability classes; match reclassification scope.

children.label: Liabilities without maturity split
children.classification_note: Total or unspecified liability measures can overlap classified amounts. Do not put originally long-term instruments wholly in noncurrent liabilities when current portions are included.

children.label: All-maturity borrowing views
children.classification_note: Net long-term debt, debt before adjustments, all-maturity notes, senior notes and drawn credit lines have overlapping measurement/instrument axes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: This long-term-debt measure is not restricted to the noncurrent portion; it is net of debt premiums/discounts and issuance costs and excludes leases. Match the current/noncurrent split before aggregation.

children.label: Long-term debt before premiums, discounts and issuance costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: Despite its name, the 2026 definition is long-term debt before unamortized premium/discount and issuance costs; it differs from net LongTermDebt and face amount at issuance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NotesPayable
concepts.review_reason: NotesPayable includes current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term notes; it is not an exclusively current borrowing category.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SeniorNotes
concepts.review_reason: SeniorNotes includes current and noncurrent portions of originally long-term senior notes; seniority overlaps other note/debt classifications.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LineOfCredit
concepts.review_reason: LineOfCredit is outstanding drawn borrowing across current/noncurrent maturities, not undrawn capacity; do not assume current classification.

children.label: All-maturity ARO and accrual views
children.classification_note: Total ARO, combined current/noncurrent accruals and accrued-plus-other liabilities overlap explicit maturity and liability-type views.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetRetirementObligation
concepts.review_reason: This ARO carrying amount includes maturity portions also supplied separately; do not add current and noncurrent ARO to this total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Combined current/noncurrent accruals contain maturity-specific accruals and can overlap broader accrued-and-other liabilities; do not force the full amount into current liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued and other liabilities have no explicit maturity split and overlap combined accruals and other-liability balances; retain outside classified subtotals until resolved.

children.label: Unclassified derivative and deferred revenue liabilities
children.classification_note: Unsplit derivative liabilities overlap classified derivative balances; deferred revenue has unresolved maturity and can include customer obligations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Derivative liabilities without maturity split can contain current and noncurrent derivative liabilities; reconcile coverage and netting against fair-value disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Deferred revenue has no maturity split and may include customer-contract liabilities plus other deferred income; do not assign it automatically to current liabilities.

nodes.label: Stockholders equity including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest

children.label: Share-capital carrying views
children.classification_note: Issued/outstanding carrying values are alternatives; no-par face value per share is supplementary. Preferred liquidation excess and share counts remain supplementary.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockValue
concepts.review_reason: Common-stock carrying value may overlap the outstanding-value or no-par common-stock alternatives; select the issuer capital presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Common-stock value outstanding can overlap common-stock carrying value and no-par stock; match issued versus outstanding and treasury treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValue
concepts.review_reason: Preferred-stock carrying value can overlap preferred value outstanding; liquidation preference is a contractual amount, not an additional carrying balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Preferred value outstanding can overlap preferred-stock carrying value; select the issuer share-capital measure rather than adding both.

children.label: Paid-in capital views
children.classification_note: All-class additional paid-in capital can contain common-only amounts; no subtotal is manufactured.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapital
concepts.review_reason: Additional paid-in capital for all share classes can include the common-only additional paid-in capital supplied separately.

children.label: Additional paid in capital common stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapitalCommonStock
concepts.review_reason: Common-only additional paid-in capital is included in the all-class paid-in-capital measure where both are reported.

children.label: Retained earnings and accumulated OCI
children.classification_note: Retained earnings/deficit and accumulated OCI are equity balances; signs follow issuer facts and are not automatically inverted.

children.label: Accumulated other comprehensive income loss net of tax
Treasury and stock-subscription deductions
children.classification_note: Treasury all-class/common-only values overlap; subscription notes represent contributed equity receivable and require contra-equity versus asset confirmation. No automatic sign inversion is prescribed.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockValue
concepts.review_reason: All treasury-stock cost can contain the common-only treasury cost supplied separately and is a deduction from equity, not a negative share count.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonValue
concepts.review_reason: Common treasury-stock cost is contained in all-class treasury cost and is already deducted from equity; do not deduct both cost presentations.

concepts.name: us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteSubscriptionsReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Stock subscription notes receivable represent equity contributions promised by note rather than cash; verify contra-equity versus asset presentation and do not treat them as ordinary trade receivables.

nodes.label: Alternative entity ownership presentations
nodes.classification_note: LLC members equity and partnership capital are alternatives to corporate equity presentations for different legal forms, not extra equity components.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MembersEquity
concepts.review_reason: Members equity is an LLC ownership presentation and is not additive to corporate stockholders equity or partnership capital for the same entity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PartnersCapital
concepts.review_reason: Partners capital is a partnership ownership presentation, not a component to add to members or corporate equity alternatives.

nodes.label: Temporary and redeemable equity
nodes.classification_note: Parent temporary equity differs from redeemable NCI; terms determine liability/temporary/permanent classification and no automatic equity summation is implied.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributableToParent
concepts.review_reason: Parent-attributable temporary equity is outside permanent equity only when instrument terms support that presentation; it excludes redeemable NCI presented separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable noncontrolling equity is distinct from parent temporary equity and permanent NCI; determine redemption terms and reporting classification.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Shares/per-share values, fair-value alternatives, contractual amounts and unresolved producer-specific candidates are kept outside primary monetary carrying totals.

children.label: Share and per-share disclosures
children.classification_note: Authorized, issued, outstanding and treasury shares and par values have different units and roles; they are not monetary equity additions.

children.label: Common stock par or stated value per share
Preferred stock par or stated value per share
Temporary equity par or stated value per share
No-par common stock face amount per share

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockNoParValue
concepts.review_reason: Despite its name, the official definition is face amount per share of no-par common stock and the schema uses per-share units; it must not be mapped to aggregate common-stock carrying value.

children.label: Derivative fair-value disclosures
children.classification_note: Generic fair values are before master-netting arrangements and can differ from recognized derivative balances; do not add them to classified carrying amounts.

children.label: Derivative fair value of derivative asset

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeAsset
concepts.review_reason: The generic derivative fair-value asset disclosure is before master-netting arrangements and may differ from recognized current/noncurrent derivative assets.

children.label: Derivative fair value of derivative liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeFairValueOfDerivativeLiability
concepts.review_reason: The generic derivative fair-value liability disclosure is before master-netting arrangements and may not equal recognized current/noncurrent net derivative liabilities.

children.label: Financing and preference terms
children.classification_note: Debt issuance face value and preferred liquidation excess are contractual disclosures, not extra debt/equity carrying values.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount
concepts.review_reason: Debt face amount is measured at issuance and need not equal reporting-date outstanding principal or net carrying debt; retain as financing disclosure.

children.label: Preferred liquidation preference excess over par

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue
concepts.review_reason: Preferred liquidation preference value is the aggregate excess over par/stated value under the official definition, not preferred carrying value or full redemption principal.

children.label: Commitments and unresolved deposit liabilities
children.classification_note: Commitments do not establish recognition. Deposits means deposit liabilities held, not posted security deposits; producer-specific nature and maturity require review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingencies
concepts.review_reason: Commitments and contingencies do not establish a separately recognized liability; retain the disclosure outside liability totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Deposits
concepts.review_reason: Deposits means deposit liabilities held, not security deposits posted as assets; issuer context and maturity are required before primary classification for an oil/gas producer.

children.label: Receivable allowance with unresolved portfolio
children.classification_note: Premium/other-receivable allowance has unresolved portfolio and maturity and must not be deducted from unrelated oil/gas receivables.

children.label: Allowance for doubtful accounts premiums and other receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsPremiumsAndOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: This allowance covers premium and other receivables with no maturity restriction; confirm the insured/other portfolio before applying it to oil/gas trade or joint-interest receivables.
